items.evidence: Payouts for our named executive officers under the annual cash incentive program are first determined quantitatively based on an equal weighting of the net sales and operating income performance measures

The Compensation Committee chose net sales and operating income, calculated in accordance with generally accepted accounting principles, as the financial performance measures for the 2021 annual cash incentive program.
The ESG Modifier is based on a holistic evaluation by the Compensation Committee of key accomplishments and actions taken during the year to advance our Apple values
The number of performance-based RSUs that vest depends entirely on Apple's total shareholder return relative to the other companies in the S&P 500

equal_split.evidence: based on an equal weighting of the net sales and operating income performance measures
